reason: changed 1 test file(s); 1 assertion(s) still do not test what their SPEC says after 2 round(s)

findings.text: SPEC-1's assertion establishes only part of the requirement: The three SPEC-1 assertions cover `timed_out`, `out_of_turns`, and `interrupted` — 3 of the 10 non-pass outcomes in the system's outcome vocabulary — so an implementation that only flags those three specific outcomes would pass all three assertions while leaving `fail`, `unusable`, `throttled`, `rate_limited`, `unavailable`, `misconfigured`, and `broken` unflagged, meaning the requirement's "any non-pass outcome" is not established.
